wkGaehQ5K-mMBAn6EX_62w.zh: 美國紐約州今年截至10/3累計108例確定病例,鑑於該州及鄰近地區病例增加,於10/5發佈行政命令,宣佈進入緊急狀態,主要擴大疫苗施打對象,並持續提供臨床指引、病例調查與接觸者追蹤及加速實驗室檢驗。該國今年截至10/2累計47個行政區報告3,887例確定病例,已逾去年全年2,289例,95%為未接種疫苗或情況不明,其中以賓州(963例)、南卡羅萊納(670例)及猶他州(535例)為主。 澳洲南澳州阿德萊德(Adelaide)某中學發生群聚,截至9/24累計5例確定病例,該州今年迄今累計9例確定病例,去年全年僅7 例。澳洲今年病例持續增加,截至9月底累計119例,低於去年全年181例,惟已明顯高於2022‒24年同期及全年水準。病例主要與海外感染及輸入病例相關,該國提供未接種2劑疫苗者免費施打疫苗。 敘利亞今年截至第33週累計765例經實驗室檢驗之確定病例,當局與UNICEF、WHO等國際組織合作,於7月下旬在高風險地區啟動疫苗接種措施。
wkGaehQ5K-mMBAn6EX_62w.en: New York State has reported 108 confirmed cases this year as of 3 October. Given the rise in cases in the state and neighbouring areas, it issued an executive order on 5 October declaring a state of emergency, mainly expanding the eligible population for vaccination, and continues to provide clinical guidance, case investigation, contact tracing and accelerated laboratory testing. As of 2 October, the United States had reported 3,887 confirmed cases this year across 47 jurisdictions, already exceeding the 2,289 cases reported for all of last year; 95% were unvaccinated or of unknown vaccination status, mainly in Pennsylvania (963 cases), South Carolina (670) and Utah (535). A cluster has occurred at a secondary school in Adelaide, South Australia, with 5 confirmed cases as of 24 September; the state has recorded 9 confirmed cases this year, compared with only 7 for all of last year. Australia has 119 cumulative cases as of the end of September, below the 181 for all of last year but clearly above the same period and full-year levels for 2022–24. Cases are mainly linked to overseas infection and imported cases, and the country provides free vaccination to people who have not received two doses. Syria has reported 765 laboratory-confirmed cases as of week 33 this year; working with UNICEF, WHO and other international organisations, authorities launched vaccination in high-risk areas in late July.

9PNGBxUuMmUlyoPgohS5KA.zh: 澳洲疫情持續,8/24-9/6累計31,650例確定病例,較前2週(24,883例)增加27.2%,今年截至9/6累計報告130,355例,較去年同期減少62.6%,陽性率上升至8.4%,病毒型別主要以A(H3N2)佔71.1%為主,疫苗覆蓋率為30.2%,整體活動度仍低於去年。惟推估疫情尚未達高峰,將持續升溫;近期兒童及高齡族群住院數亦增加。
9PNGBxUuMmUlyoPgohS5KA.en: Influenza activity in Australia continues. Between 24 August and 6 September, 31,650 confirmed cases were reported, 27.2% more than in the previous two weeks (24,883 cases). Cumulatively this year as of 6 September, 130,355 cases have been reported, 62.6% lower than in the same period last year. The positivity rate has risen to 8.4%; influenza A(H3N2) accounts for 71.1% of virus types, vaccination coverage is 30.2%, and overall activity remains below last year's level. However, activity is estimated not to have peaked yet and will continue to rise; recently, hospitalisations among children and older people have also increased.

cvLz3QVVa2CvVwnzaBCBCw.zh: 澳洲西澳大利亞州(Western Australia)疫情上升,今年迄今累計 36例確定病例,已高於過去2年整年病例數(2025年28例、 2024年23例),迄無死亡病例,多數病例為本土感染,且為第二分支之 IIb子分支(Clade IIb)。另感染者已從GBMSM族群擴大至異性戀男女,當局已提供高風險群體免費接種兩劑疫苗。該國疫情上升,今年共報告166例,自2022年迄今累計報告1,973例。 哥斯大黎加報告今年第3例確定病例,為37歲男性,調查顯示與第2例病例具流病關聯。疫情自首都聖荷西省擴散至埃雷迪亞省 ,當局已啟動接觸者追蹤。目前該國今年報告之 3 例確定病例病況皆穩定(均為成年男性,年齡介於27- 52歲間)。去(2025)年累計報告5例,自2022年迄今累計報告235例確定病例,其中1例死亡。
cvLz3QVVa2CvVwnzaBCBCw.en: Mpox cases are rising in Western Australia. So far this year, 36 confirmed cases have been reported, which is higher than the full-year totals of the past two years (28 in 2025 and 23 in 2024). No deaths have been reported to date. Most cases are locally acquired infections of Clade IIb, a subclade of the second clade. Infections have also spread from gay, bisexual and other men who have sex with men (GBMSM) to heterosexual men and women. Authorities are providing free two-dose vaccination to high-risk groups. Australia has reported 166 cases this year and 1,973 cumulative cases since 2022. In Costa Rica, the country has reported its third confirmed case this year, a 37-year-old man. Investigation shows an epidemiological link to the second case. The outbreak has spread from the capital province of San José to Heredia Province, and authorities have started contact tracing. The three confirmed cases reported this year are all in stable condition (all adult men aged 27 to 52 years). Costa Rica reported 5 cases last year and has reported 235 confirmed cases since 2022, including 1 death.

EqJ7E9-CHQS6dJY97F1xaQ.zh: 澳洲疫情持續蔓延,通報170例報告,疫情集中在金伯利(135例),皮爾巴拉(31例)和金礦區(4例),並擴展至中西部地區,今年累計410例確定病例。因應疫情跨區擴散,當局啟動擴大疫苗接種計畫,提高疫苗接種覆蓋率,降低疾病傳播風險。
EqJ7E9-CHQS6dJY97F1xaQ.en: Diphtheria continues to spread in Australia, with 170 cases reported. Cases are concentrated in the Kimberley (135 cases), Pilbara (31) and Goldfields (4) regions, and the outbreak has spread to the Midwest region. This year, 410 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively. In response to cross-regional spread, authorities have launched an expanded vaccination programme to increase vaccination coverage and reduce transmission risk.

jGKYoFtOUgZ4gLWQpheXrA.zh: 全球自2022年截至今年5/31累計144國/地區報告18萬5,882例確定病例,其中509例死亡。 今年5月共計32國家/地區報告1,142例確定病例,其中3例死亡(CFR 0.3%),以馬達加斯加(649例)、中國(89例)、法國(63例)、澳洲(50例)及德國(45例)為高,63.9%的病例來自非洲地區。相較今年4月,西太平洋區及非洲區病例數呈上升趨勢 ,其餘地區疫情則下降,挪威通報首例Ib型病例,另波蘭先前的I型病例確定為Ib型次分支。 非洲地區近6週(5/4-6/14)共計10國報告790例確定病例,其中3 例死亡(CFR 0.45%),以馬達加斯加、肯亞、幾內亞、南蘇丹、喀麥隆及剛果⺠主共和國為高;非洲以外地區,為西班牙與泰國持續報告Ib型社區傳播。 馬達加斯加自2025年12月以來面臨全球最大規模的Ib型疫情,截至今年6/14,累計2,117例確定病例與7例死亡(多為免疫低下者)。疫情已擴及全國60%的行政區(69/115),主要影響15-49 歲族群。雖已推動MVA-BN疫苗接種(超過7.9萬人施打),惟面臨疫苗缺貨、冷鏈物流與醫療量能挑戰,疫情迄未受到控制。
jGKYoFtOUgZ4gLWQpheXrA.en: Globally, from 2022 through 31 May this year, 144 countries and territories have reported 185,882 confirmed cases, including 509 deaths. In May this year, 32 countries and territories reported 1,142 confirmed cases, including 3 deaths (CFR 0.3%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (649), China (89), France (63), Australia (50) and Germany (45), and 63.9% of cases came from the African Region. Compared with April this year, case numbers rose in the Western Pacific and African Regions and declined in other regions. Norway reported its first clade Ib case, and Poland's earlier clade I case has been identified as a clade Ib sub-lineage. In the African Region, over the past 6 weeks (4 May–14 June), 10 countries reported 790 confirmed cases, including 3 deaths (CFR 0.45%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar, Kenya, Guinea, South Sudan, Cameroon and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Outside Africa, Spain and Thailand continued to report clade Ib community transmission. Madagascar has faced the world's largest clade Ib outbreak since December 2025. As of 14 June this year, 2,117 confirmed cases and 7 deaths (mostly among immunocompromised people) have been reported cumulatively. The outbreak has spread to 60% of the country's administrative areas (69 of 115), mainly affecting people aged 15 to 49 years. Although MVA-BN vaccination has been rolled out (more than 79,000 people vaccinated), the outbreak remains uncontrolled because of challenges including vaccine shortages, cold chain logistics and health system capacity.

_Mg1iRmtfmOF8lA4qSwn3w.zh: 澳大利亞疫情嚴峻,今年截至5/20累計報告逾231例病例,為近年年平均病例數的30倍,且報告近10年首例死亡案例,疫情自北領地(Northern Territory)擴散至西澳州及昆士蘭等地,25%病患需住院治療,當局已加強疫苗接種及醫護人力支援等措施。
_Mg1iRmtfmOF8lA4qSwn3w.en: Australia's outbreak is severe: as of 20 May this year, more than 231 cases have been reported cumulatively, which is 30 times the average annual number of cases in recent years. The country has reported its first death in nearly 10 years. The outbreak has spread from the Northern Territory to Western Australia and Queensland, among other states. 25% of patients required hospitalisation. Authorities have strengthened vaccination and healthcare workforce support.

vvSLX4KAElD8lLyPIG07Ig.zh: 澳洲北領地愛麗斯泉報告2例死亡病例,分別發生於2026年4、5月,雨季降雨量增加導致北領地蚊子數量上升,疾病傳播風險亦上升,通常於3-5月間病例數較高,大多數感染僅引起輕微發熱性疾病,少數病例進展為嚴重神經系統疾病,包括腦炎。當地已啟動蚊子監測及控制措施。
vvSLX4KAElD8lLyPIG07Ig.en: Alice Springs in the Northern Territory of Australia has reported two deaths, occurring in April and May 2026. Increased rainfall in the wet season has led to rising mosquito numbers in the Northern Territory, and the risk of transmission has also increased. Cases usually peak between March and May. Most infections cause only mild febrile illness, while a small number progress to severe neurological disease, including encephalitis. Mosquito surveillance and control measures have been activated locally.

lbJuzLLElB6hK7J3OY9U1g.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於4/30-5/6期間,WPV1新增巴基斯坦2例;cVDPV2新增3國共6例,分別為奈及利亞3例、查德2例、剛果民主共和國1例;cVDPV3新增奈及利亞2例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增2國共20件,分別為巴基斯坦14件、阿富汗6件,cVDPV2新增澳大利亞1件(前已掌握)。
lbJuzLLElB6hK7J3OY9U1g.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 30 April and 6 May, WPV1 added two cases in Pakistan; cVDPV2 added six cases across three countries: three in Nigeria, two in Chad and one in the DRC; and cVDPV3 added two cases in Nigeria. For environmental samples, WPV1 added 20 specimens across two countries: 14 in Pakistan and six in Afghanistan. cVDPV2 added one specimen in Australia, which had already been reported.

sSGfCo8Hdi5E4sG8tnhkXg.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於4/23-29期間,cVDPV2新增3國共4例,分別為查德2例、剛果民主共和國/奈及利亞各21例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦6件,cVDPV2新增2國共2件,分別為馬拉威/奈及利亞各1件。 澳洲西部珀斯(Perth)於4月中旬檢出 1 件cVDPV2環境樣本,基因定序與近年於非洲、歐洲及巴布亞紐幾內亞檢出之病毒相近,因當地疫苗覆蓋率達92%,且無社區傳播跡象,當局評估風險為非常低,推測可能為旅外人員將病毒排泄至汙水系統。另該國最近 1 例人類案例係發生於1972年。
sSGfCo8Hdi5E4sG8tnhkXg.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 23 and 29 April, cVDPV2 added four cases across three countries: two in Chad, and 21 each in the DRC and Nigeria. For environmental samples, WPV1 added six specimens in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 added two specimens across two countries, one each in Malawi and Nigeria. In mid-April, one cVDPV2 environmental sample was detected in Perth, Western Australia. Its genetic sequence is similar to viruses detected in recent years in Africa, Europe and Papua New Guinea. Because local vaccination coverage reaches 92% and there are no signs of community transmission, authorities assess the risk as very low and speculate that the virus may have been excreted into the sewage system by someone who travelled abroad. The country's most recent human case occurred in 1972.

-jjFp74pJK9V-vqmTYchIQ.zh: 澳洲北領地 (NT) 於今年3/20-26報告4例確定病例,自去年累計報告33例皮膚白喉確定病例,已超過往年趨勢,當局亦已發布警示,並建議民眾檢視自身及家人疫苗接種情形。
-jjFp74pJK9V-vqmTYchIQ.en: The Northern Territory (NT) of Australia reported 4 confirmed cases during 20–26 March this year. Since last year, 33 confirmed cases of cutaneous diphtheria have been reported cumulatively, exceeding past trends. Authorities have issued a warning and recommend that the public check the vaccination status of themselves and their family members.

V0agBIgqaaPdXCUPz_Vr2Q.zh: 疫情更新:  今年第7週(2/9-15)全球陽性率為3.28%,與上週3.31%相當,其中美洲區署陽性率明顯增加。 香港疫情於低點持平,第9週(2/22-28)陽性率為0.08%,汙水監測變異株以NB.1.8.1為多(占62.8%)。 印疫情略升,第7週陽性率上升為3.67%。 澳洲疫情呈上升趨勢,1/26-2/22平均陽性率為2.2%,疫情已連續4週上升,近期變異株以XFG占多數(占33.7%);另近1年成人疫苗覆蓋率為10%,其中以75歲以上覆蓋率(38.5%)為高。  評估與建議: 近期全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(占56.16%),其次為NB.1.8.1(25.37%)。WHO公布之全球長期快速風險評估(第9版),評估對全球公共衛生的整體風險屬中等。鑑於自然感染與疫苗帶來的群體免疫力提升,以及臨床治療的進步,全球住院與死亡數自2022年以來明顯下降。 目前多數流行變異株為Omicron JN.1及其衍生亞型,雖具備免疫逃脫能力,惟不至於造成疾病嚴重度增加,僅有6%的有症狀病例出現長新冠症狀;現階段尚未形成穩定季節性流行規律,多數國家已減少常規檢測通報,汙水與定醫監測成為重要的補充監測方式。 WHO指出,目前疫苗仍能有效預防重症與死亡,並建議優先保護高風險族群、與流感疫苗共同施打;同時透過《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計畫》呼籲各國整合防治計畫,持續加強監測、保護高風險族群、維持醫療與公衛韌性,並落實風險溝通。
V0agBIgqaaPdXCUPz_Vr2Q.en: Epidemic update: In week 7 of this year (9–15 February), the global positivity rate was 3.28%, similar to 3.31% the previous week, with a notable increase in the WHO Regional Office for the Americas. Hong Kong's epidemic has remained flat at a low point; the positivity rate in week 9 (22–28 February) was 0.08%, and NB.1.8.1 was the predominant variant in wastewater surveillance (62.8%). India's epidemic has risen slightly, with the positivity rate rising to 3.67% in week 7. Australia's epidemic is rising: the average positivity rate for 26 January–22 February was 2.2%, and it has risen for four consecutive weeks, with XFG the majority of recent variants (33.7%). In addition, adult vaccination coverage over the past year was 10%, with higher coverage among people aged 75 and over (38.5%). Assessment and recommendations: XFG currently has the highest share of circulating variants globally (56.16%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (25.37%). WHO's global long-term rapid risk assessment (9th edition) rates the overall risk to global public health as moderate. Given population immunity from natural infection and vaccination, and advances in clinical treatment, global hospitalizations and deaths have declined markedly since 2022. Most circulating variants are Omicron JN.1 and its descendant subtypes; although they have immune escape capacity, they do not cause greater disease severity, but only 6% of symptomatic cases develop long COVID symptoms. COVID-19 has not yet established a stable seasonal pattern, and most countries have reduced routine testing and reporting, so wastewater and sentinel physician surveillance have become important supplementary methods. WHO notes that current vaccines remain effective at preventing severe disease and death, and recommends prioritizing high-risk groups and co-administration with influenza vaccines. Through its Strategic Plan for Coronavirus Disease Threat Management, WHO calls on countries to integrate prevention and control plans, continue strengthening surveillance, protect high-risk groups, maintain health system and public health resilience, and implement risk communication.

TYTqT-VQnFpoSwW_iMJFwQ.zh: 疫情更新:  今年第2週(1/5-11)全球陽性率上升至4.13%,其中,西太平洋、歐洲及東南亞區署陽性率明顯增加。WHO FluNet 澳大利亞疫情呈上下波動,第2週陽性率為1.78%,近期變異株以NB.1.8.1為主(45.8%)。澳洲疾管局 1/9、WHO1/27 歐洲今年第3週門診陽性率增至3.4%,變異株以XFG占多數(54%),其次為NB.1.8.1(21%)。ECDC 1/28 加拿大疫情呈上升趨勢,第2週(1/11-17)陽性率為5.4%,病患以65歲以上占多數(57%),變異株以XFG為主。Government of Canada 1/23  評估與建議: 全球近期流行變異株占比以XFG最高。鑒於COVID-19仍廣泛傳播,對高風險族群造成嚴重疾病與死亡,WHO之《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計劃》呼籲各國整合更廣泛的呼吸道和其他傳染病預防和控制計畫,強化冠狀病毒疾病威脅的整合性、永續性且具實證基礎的管理。WHO 12/2、WHO 1/27
TYTqT-VQnFpoSwW_iMJFwQ.en: Situation update: in week 2 (5–11 January), global test positivity rose to 4.13%, with notable increases in the Western Pacific, European and South-East Asia Regions (WHO FluNet). Australia's situation is fluctuating; test positivity was 1.78% in week 2, and the recent predominant variant is NB.1.8.1 (45.8%) (Australian CDC, 9 January; WHO, 27 January). In Europe, outpatient test positivity rose to 3.4% in week 3 of this year; XFG was the predominant variant (54%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (21%) (ECDC, 28 January). Canada's situation is rising; test positivity was 5.4% in week 2 (11–17 January), with patients mostly aged 65 and over (57%), and XFG is the main variant (Government of Canada, 23 January). Assessment and recommendations: XFG currently accounts for the highest share of circulating variants globally. Given that COVID-19 continues to spread widely and causes severe disease and deaths among high-risk groups, WHO's strategic plan for managing the threat of coronavirus disease calls on countries to integrate broader respiratory and other infectious disease prevention and control programmes, and to strengthen integrated, sustainable and evidence-based management of the coronavirus disease threat (WHO, 2 December; WHO, 27 January).

8RE77mLkV0cL_g8DB6bJnA.zh: 澳大利亞新南威爾斯州自2025年11月迄今累計報告6例病例,其中3例為家庭群聚,其餘病例感染源仍不明,因1月下旬適逢當地音樂節,當局評估此波疫情可能因音樂活動擴散,已提供疫苗與免疫球蛋白予接觸者,呼籲高風險對象採取防疫措施。
8RE77mLkV0cL_g8DB6bJnA.en: In New South Wales, Australia, 6 cases have been reported cumulatively since November 2025. Three were household clusters, and the source of the other cases remains unknown. Because a local music festival took place in late January, authorities assess that this wave may spread through music events. Vaccines and immunoglobulin have been provided to contacts, and high-risk individuals are urged to take preventive measures.

1ZonIlpAw7ucUOrR85HNjg.en: As of 30 December 2025, 44 US states had reported 49 outbreaks and 2,065 confirmed cases in 2025, of which 235 were hospitalised and 3 died. 93% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Cases were most numerous in Texas (803), Arizona (196) and South Carolina (181). Recent activity is concentrated in South Carolina, Arizona and Utah. Infected travellers also passed through Newark Liberty International Airport in New Jersey, Boston Logan Airport in Massachusetts and Denver International Airport in Colorado, and authorities warn of possible transmission risk. The US case count for 2025 is the highest in nearly 30 years; 285 cases were reported in 2024. New South Wales and South Australia issued alerts after a traveller returning from Southeast Asia visited parts of Sydney and Adelaide during the infectious period, posing a possible transmission risk. Authorities advise people who were at the exposure locations at the specified times to monitor their health and seek medical care promptly if symptoms appear. Australia reported 179 cases in 2025, three times the 2024 number, mostly linked to travel.

IYCxAnqinSYxd7ya2gLCFQ.en: Sydney, Australia, reported 3 confirmed cases between 9 and 18 December. b6QO_JnGrFryNQpLPpC5dw.en: Situation update: global test positivity was 6.36% in week 46 of 2025 (10–16 November), with increases in the African Region. 0siGk2D8X19uQ6sCLjJbOg.en: Australia reported 44 cases on 8 November. Patients are distributed across four states, including New South Wales. The suspected source is alfalfa sprouts sold by a certain producer, and the product has been removed from shelves.

0Q8G9y9SBvW1tGaXVpeNaA.en: On 10 November, Canada announced that PAHO had notified it that it no longer maintains measles elimination status, which it had held since 1998. The country has experienced a large-scale, multi-regional outbreak since October 2024. As of 1 November this year, 10 regions had reported 4,800 confirmed cases, including 2 deaths. Although the outbreak has slowed recently, it has persisted for more than 12 months, mainly in communities with lower vaccination rates. After the PAHO commission reviewed recent epidemiological and laboratory data, it confirmed that the same virus strain had been circulating in the country for more than one year. Authorities have strengthened cooperation with PAHO and local governments to raise vaccination rates and enhance surveillance. Australia: In Western Australia, 54 confirmed cases had been reported as of 6 November this year, mainly in the south-western and southern regions. All patients had either travel history to countries in South-East or South Asia or contact with a confirmed case. This is the state's most severe outbreak in 30 years; only six cases were reported in 2023–24. Authorities have published venues where confirmed cases were exposed, and recommend that visitors monitor their own symptoms. New Zealand: As of 7 November this year, 18 confirmed cases had been reported. Recent new cases are mostly locally acquired, including 7 cases from a Bluebridge Ferry cluster. Authorities have traced more than 3,000 contacts and reminded the public that the outbreak continues, recommending that people assess their own vaccination status and watch closely for related symptoms. Israel: As of 10 November this year, 1,935 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 9 deaths. The outbreak has spread to at least 12 cities. Authorities have expanded vaccination and reminded people to seek medical care immediately if symptoms appear. People who are not fully vaccinated should avoid gatherings in cities with outbreaks.

mQW9PsXlG_Kr1YUd7FcQEw.en: Australia's outbreak is severe: more than 420,000 cases have been reported this year, and 265 deaths as of August this year. Authorities say they will continue monitoring the outbreak to respond to its spread and urge people to take personal protective measures and get vaccinated. School cluster reports also remain at a high level: from the start of the school term in September to 29 October, 693 school clusters were reported, along with 16 severe paediatric cases, including one death. Wastewater virus surveillance will also now cover seasonal influenza viruses as a supplementary indicator to the traditional surveillance system.

q02iJuGx7Mri6EKxyM1-4w.en: Monthly update: Since May 2022 and as of 26 September this year, 141 countries and areas have reported more than 162,000 confirmed cases, of which at least 430 died (CFR 0.2%). Year to date as of week 39, 96 countries and areas have reported more than 42,000 confirmed cases: 35,363 in the African Region, 3,314 in the Region of the Americas, 2,044 in the European Region, 1,229 in the Western Pacific Region, 95 in the South-East Asia Region and 40 in the Eastern Mediterranean Region. Cases have risen in the Eastern Mediterranean and Europe and declined in Africa, the Americas, the Western Pacific and South-East Asia. Other updates: On 15 September, California, United States, reported one new clade I case, the state's second and the country's sixth clade I case. The patient had recent travel history to the Middle East and no epidemiological link to other cases. The state's first case was reported in November 2024. Senegal reported its first case in August this year; as of 23 September, a cumulative 4 cases had been reported. The first case was an imported clade Ib case. Case 2 was confirmed as clade IIb and had no epidemiological link to case 1; cases 3 and 4 were contacts of case 2, and their infection is presumed to be clade IIb. Authorities have identified 40 contacts. Ireland reported three confirmed clade Ib cases and one suspected case on 18 September. The first confirmed case was epidemiologically linked to a suspected case with travel history to the Middle East; the other two confirmed cases were close contacts of the first, one of whom was a child. All patients have recovered. Authorities assess the country's risk as still low and urge travellers abroad to take necessary public health measures. Kuwait reported its first mpox case on 10 August; it was clade IIb, and 3 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively. The first case had travel history to China, and authorities have conducted an investigation and identified contacts. Australia reported one new clade Ib case on 9 September, with travel history to China and the Philippines; it is the country's third case since January 2024. Authorities have investigated and followed up contacts, and have helped administer post-exposure vaccines. Thailand reported a new clade Ib case on 9 September; the patient is an adult man with travel history to Oman, and it is the country's sixth clade Ib case since January 2024. Assessment and recommendations: On 5 September, WHO, following the fifth meeting of the IHR Emergency Committee, recommended ending the Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). At a press conference, WHO said case and death numbers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Burundi, Sierra Leone and Uganda continue to decline, risk factors for transmission and severity are increasingly understood, and affected countries have established sustained response capacity, so the event no longer constitutes a PHEIC. WHO cautioned that ending the PHEIC does not mean the threat has disappeared, and Africa CDC continues to treat the event as an emergency health event in Africa. WHO assesses the global public health risk as moderate. Because different genotypes continue to circulate, surveillance and diagnostic capacity are insufficient, funding is lacking, and community engagement requires more resources, WHO has extended its long-term recommendations to August 2026.

R3OmGmQ_EGdjsAohMelCTA.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第31週(7/28-8/3)全球陽性率6.06%,創今年新高,美洲、歐洲、東南亞區署陽性率皆增加。 中國疫情於低點小幅度反彈,第33週(8/11-17)定醫門急診陽性率上升至11.9%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高;香港疫情小幅反彈,第33週陽性率上升至1.5%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(54%),另XFG占0.3%。 西太平洋區署第31週疫情更新,日本陽性率上升至43%,韓國陽性率上升至23%,其他國家如新加坡、印、寮國、澳洲及紐西蘭等陽性率皆下降。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,其中,美洲、歐洲、東南亞區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株由XFG占比最高,其次為NB.1.8.1及LP.8.1。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
R3OmGmQ_EGdjsAohMelCTA.en: Epidemiological update: in week 31 of 2025 (28 July–3 August), global test positivity was 6.06%, the highest this year, with increases in the Americas, Europe and South-East Asia regions. China's outbreak has rebounded slightly from a low: sentinel outpatient and emergency positivity rose to 11.9% in week 33 (11–17 August), with NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant. Hong Kong's outbreak rebounded slightly: positivity rose to 1.5% in week 33, with NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant (54%) and XFG at 0.3%. In the Western Pacific Region's week 31 update, positivity rose to 43% in Japan and 23% in South Korea, while positivity fell in other countries including Singapore, India, Lao PDR, Australia and New Zealand. Assessment and recommendations: global positivity has recently been trending upward, with the Americas, Europe and South-East Asia regions rising. The predominant global variant is XFG, followed by NB.1.8.1 and LP.8.1. WHO notes that most countries have integrated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

INK9QIjivlSTTc5aJxESkg.zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年6月截至今年7/25累計139國/地區報告15萬4千餘例確診病例,其中至少385例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 全球今年截至第30週累計79國/地區報告3萬3,370例確診病例,其中非洲區2萬8,481例、美洲區2,343例、歐洲區1,706例、西太平洋區755例、東南亞區52例及東地中海區33例。  其他更新:  中國今年截至7/31報告23例Ib型確診病例,其中7例具疫區旅遊史,包含烏干達(2例)、坦尚亞(2例)、剛果民主共和國(2例)、西非國家(剛果、馬利),另2例具泊爾及1例具阿拉伯聯合大公國旅遊史,其餘個案為本土傳播,其中,包含居住在中國之非洲僑民。WHO基於所有通報群聚事件中,指標個案均能與旅遊史有流行病學關聯,故將該國傳播分類由「未知傳播鏈」更正為「與旅遊相關個案」,惟仍無法排除尚未偵測到之社區傳播可能性。當局已在疫區進行廢水監測,並加強衛教及提供無症狀者藥物。 澳大利亞7/19報告新增2例Ib型病例,案1近期有烏干達旅遊史,案2為案1家庭接觸者,當局已加強監測疫情。 英國7/22新增1例Ib型病例,為成年男性,具肯亞旅遊史,當局已展開疫調與監測,並提供接觸者疫苗。  評估與建議: WHO於2025年6月5日召開國際衛生條例(IHR)緊急委員會第四次會議,討論2024年M痘疫情上升的情形。會議確認該事件仍構成國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC),並針對受影響國家提出各項臨時建議,包括加強監測、提升診斷能力、推動疫苗接種、改善臨床護理、強化跨境合作,以及加強社區參與和資金支持,並將現行建議延長至2025年8月20日。
INK9QIjivlSTTc5aJxESkg.en: Monthly update: since June 2022 and as of 25 July this year, 139 countries and territories have cumulatively reported more than 154,000 confirmed cases, of which at least 385 died (CFR: 0.2%). This year, as of week 30, 79 countries and territories have cumulatively reported 33,370 confirmed cases: African Region 28,481; Region of the Americas 2,343; European Region 1,706; Western Pacific Region 755; South-East Asia Region 52; and Eastern Mediterranean Region 33. Other updates: China reported 23 confirmed clade Ib cases as of 31 July this year, of which seven had travel history to affected areas, including Uganda (2), Tanzania (2), the DRC (2), and West African countries (Congo, Mali); two had travel history to Nepal and one to the UAE. The other cases were locally transmitted, including African nationals living in China. Based on all reported clusters in which the index cases had epidemiological links to travel, WHO has reclassified China's transmission category from 'unknown transmission chain' to 'travel-associated cases', although undetected community transmission cannot be ruled out. Authorities have launched wastewater surveillance in affected areas, strengthened health education, and provided medicines to asymptomatic people. Australia reported two new clade Ib cases on 19 July: case 1 had recent travel history to Uganda, and case 2 was a household contact of case 1; authorities have strengthened surveillance. The UK reported one new clade Ib case on 22 July, an adult male with travel history to Kenya; authorities have launched epidemiological investigation and surveillance and provided vaccines to contacts. Assessment and recommendations: WHO held the fourth meeting of the IHR Emergency Committee on 5 June 2025 to discuss the rise in mpox since 2024. The meeting confirmed that the event still constitutes a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), and issued temporary recommendations for affected countries, including strengthening surveillance, improving diagnostic capacity, promoting vaccination, improving clinical care, strengthening cross-border cooperation, and enhancing community engagement and financial support. Current recommendations were extended to 20 August 2025.

iIXRjsDkYIgvCYsT6A3KHQ.en: Australia has reported about 210,000 cases cumulatively so far this year as of June. Cases from January to May were 30% higher than the same period last year, and recent hospitalizations have risen by 50%. Nationwide influenza vaccination coverage is below 30%, while coverage among people aged 65 and over is 59%.

qN7MMmw-cTKCcomL1Vjt6w.zh: 澳大利亞昆士蘭州今年截至7/20累計報告233例,其中35例死亡,病例數為去(2024)年同期3倍以上,病例多集中於凱恩斯及湯斯維爾區,專家推測疫情與降雨量高於平均及高速公路工程之環境影響相關。 泰國今年截至7/9累計報告1,676例,其中72例死亡,病患主要分布於東北地區,年齡以60歲以上族群為多,當局提醒民眾食用熟食及避免涉水或至泥濘區域,或應穿戴靴子和手套等防護裝備,並於接觸後清洗身體,另呼籲農民及糖尿病患者,應留意自身感染風險。
qN7MMmw-cTKCcomL1Vjt6w.en: Queensland, Australia, has reported 233 cases so far this year as of 20 July, including 35 deaths. This is more than three times the number in the same period last year. Cases are concentrated in the Cairns and Townsville areas. Experts suspect the outbreak is linked to above-average rainfall and the environmental impact of highway construction. Thailand has reported 1,676 cases so far this year as of 9 July, including 72 deaths. Cases are mainly in the northeast, and most patients are aged over 60. Authorities advise people to eat well-cooked food, avoid wading or entering muddy areas, wear protective gear such as boots and gloves where appropriate, and wash the body after exposure. Farmers and people with diabetes are also urged to be aware of their risk of infection.

Hq86C_GLBhMLVBQEvCuJpw.en: New South Wales, Australia, reported one death, a man in his 50s who had been bitten months earlier by an infected bat and had received treatment. KwaZulu-Natal Province in eastern South Africa reported one death, a 32-year-old man who was bitten by a dog in March and was unvaccinated. He died on 30 May. o873ur_A3pgZQT2TBbr2zQ.en: Epidemic update: in week 19 of 2025 (5–11 May), the global positivity rate was about 3%, with more significant increases in the Eastern Mediterranean, Western Pacific and South-East Asia regions. WHO reports that the global outbreak has risen significantly since February this year, and recent positivity rates are approaching last July's peak. The share of the LP.8.1 variant has declined since mid-April, while the share of NB.1.8.1 has risen to 10.7% in mid-May. WHO assesses that the current global risk remains high, although public health risk has not so far been affected by the variants under monitoring. In weeks 17–20 (20 April–17 May), positivity in Singapore rose from 13% to 20%; in Australia it rose from 2.4% to 3%, with XEC and LP.8.1 the most prevalent variants; in Malaysia, positivity in weeks 15–18 continued to rise, from 8% to 24%, with at least 110 cases reported daily. Hong Kong's positivity in week 21 was 11.1%, lower than the previous week (13.8%). The outbreak remains at a high level but has begun to decline, and sentinel clinic consultation rates have also fallen; wastewater and respiratory sample surveillance show NB.1.8.1 as the most prevalent variant. Assessment and recommendations: global positivity has recently been trending upward, including in the Eastern Mediterranean, Western Pacific, European and South-East Asian regions, and the LP.8.1 variant still accounts for the largest share globally. WHO notes that most countries have incorporated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infectious disease surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early-warning surveillance systems and continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

JsA7TxngVpqRSnydaaWwDw.en: Queensland, Australia, has reported nearly 2,400 cases since the beginning of this year, 3.5 times the average for 2023–24. The state reported more than 15,000 cases last year, and last year's annual total exceeded the combined total of the previous 11 years. Japan's outbreak is severe. In the most recent week (12–18 May), 2,299 cases were reported, an increase of more than 500 from 1,792 the previous week, reaching a high not seen since 2018. The largest number of new cases was in Tokyo Metropolis (151), followed by Hyogo Prefecture (140). So far this year, more than 19,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, and severe cases and deaths among infants have been reported. The Japanese Society of Pediatrics urges parents to have infants aged 2 months and older vaccinated with routine vaccines as soon as possible, and recommends booster doses for children.

9dhf7xmbsSZIRJ1RvTDqrw.zh: 澳大利亞昆士蘭州今年截至5/18累計報告219例,其中31例死亡,病例數為去(2024)年同期3倍以上,今年累計病例數高於2020-24年全年病例數,病例多集中於凱恩斯及湯斯維爾區,其中湯斯維爾北部郊區發生群聚感染。
9dhf7xmbsSZIRJ1RvTDqrw.en: Queensland, Australia, has reported 219 cases cumulatively as of 18 May this year, including 31 deaths. Case numbers are more than triple those of the same period last year, and cumulative cases this year exceed the full-year totals for 2020–24. Cases are concentrated in the Cairns and Townsville areas, and a cluster of infections has occurred in the northern suburbs of Townsville.

JID15r3l9zYEN3QeVd_R_w.zh: 摩洛哥自2023年10月爆發疫情以來,截至今年4/13全國共12個地區報告2.5萬餘例疑病例,其中1.3萬餘例確診及184例死亡,該國於今年1月下旬達高峰後,已連續10週呈下降趨勢,經基因定序顯示多為B3基因型,該基因型於非洲地區流行,亦與全球疫情相關。目前疫情已受控制,惟部分地區仍持續傳播,惟該國麻疹-德國麻疹(MR)疫苗接種率僅73.6%,WHO評估該國未接種疫苗/未完全接種疫苗者與免疫功能低下者風險為「中」,由於處非/歐洲交接處,人員流動頻繁,評估區域及全球風險為「中」。 北美洲疫情更新,美國今年截至5/8報告14起疫情,累計31州1,001例,其中126例住院及3例死亡,以德州逾700例為多,今年僅4個多月,病例數已接近2019年全年病例數(1,274),其為1992年以來病例數最高峰;加拿大今年截至4/26共7省1,506例,以安大略省(1,249)為多,另亞伯達省病例數迅速上升,截至5/12累計報告362例;墨西哥北部契瓦瓦州(Chihuahua)疫情嚴峻,今年迄今報告954例,其中1例死亡,該國今年迄今累計1,003例。 澳大利亞爆發近6年來最嚴重疫情,今年迄今累計報告72例,超過去(2024)年全年病例數(57例),分布以維多利亞州27例為多,其次為新南威爾斯州(21)及西澳大利亞州(18),超過6成病例為29歲以下族群。
JID15r3l9zYEN3QeVd_R_w.en: Morocco: since its outbreak began in October 2023, as of 13 April this year, 12 regions nationwide have reported more than 25,000 suspected cases, of which more than 13,000 were confirmed and 184 died. The country peaked in late January this year and has since declined for 10 consecutive weeks. Genetic sequencing shows that most cases are genotype B3, which circulates in Africa and is also linked to the global outbreak. The outbreak is now under control, but transmission continues in some areas. Morocco's measles-rubella (MR) vaccination coverage is only 73.6%. WHO assesses the risk for unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated people and immunocompromised people in the country as moderate. Because the country sits at the junction of Africa and Europe with frequent population movement, the regional and global risk is also assessed as moderate. North America update: as of 8 May, the United States has reported 14 outbreaks, with 1,001 cases cumulatively across 31 states, including 126 hospitalizations and 3 deaths; Texas has the most, with over 700 cases. In just over four months this year, case numbers are close to the 2019 full-year total (1,274), the highest since 1992. As of 26 April, Canada had 1,506 cases across 7 provinces this year, mainly in Ontario (1,249); Alberta's case numbers have risen rapidly, with 362 cases reported cumulatively as of 12 May. The outbreak in Chihuahua State in northern Mexico is severe, with 954 cases reported this year so far, including 1 death; the country has reported 1,003 cases so far this year. Australia is experiencing its most severe outbreak in nearly six years, with 72 cases reported so far this year, exceeding last year's full-year total (57 cases). Victoria had the most (27 cases), followed by New South Wales (21) and Western Australia (18). More than 60% of cases were aged 29 years or younger.

Ybv1xcysxNmFXpDRj6wrIw.zh: 澳大利亞維多利亞州爆發近10年以來最嚴重疫情,今年迄今累計23例,超過去年全年病例數,當地本土病例數上升,多數病例未完整接種疫苗,當局表示大墨爾本及鄰近地區傳播風險上升,亦須持續因應返國旅客之境外移入風險。 越南疫情更新,近1週(4/19-4/25)新增3,900餘例,較前1週減少4.3%,近期多數地區疫情已趨緩,惟北部地區疫情仍持續,今年截至4月下旬已累計8.1萬例。目前共52個省達疫苗覆蓋率95%以上目標,然偏遠地區及都會地區接種率仍偏低,部分民眾存在疫苗猶豫及基層醫事人員不足,致疫情控制仍面臨挑戰。 ECDC公布2024年麻疹流行病學報告,於去年報告3.5萬餘例,較2023年3,900餘例上升近10倍,歐洲地區於2023年疫情開始上升,2024年通報率為每百萬人77.4例,高於2023年9.1例,亦高於疫情前水平(27.2例),其中以羅馬亞為高,占歐盟病例87%。病例多為1歲以下嬰兒,惟部分國家成人病例數占比達28-53%,去年23例死亡病例中有22例來自羅馬亞,逾半為5歲以下兒童。歐盟會員國去年第1劑接種率為93.9%,低於2023年94.2%,僅4國第2劑接種率達95%目標,多數會員國未達接種建議水準。
Ybv1xcysxNmFXpDRj6wrIw.en: Victoria State in Australia has experienced its most severe outbreak in nearly 10 years, with 23 cases cumulatively this year, exceeding last year's full-year total. Locally acquired cases have increased, and most cases were not fully vaccinated. Authorities say the risk of transmission has risen in Greater Melbourne and nearby areas, and the imported risk from returning travelers must continue to be addressed. Viet Nam update: in the most recent week (19–25 April), more than 3,900 new cases were reported, a 4.3% decrease from the previous week. The outbreak has eased in most areas recently, but it continues in the northern region, and 81,000 cases have been reported cumulatively this year as of late April. Currently 52 provinces have reached the target of 95% vaccination coverage, but coverage remains low in remote and urban areas, and some people are hesitant about vaccines and there is a shortage of primary healthcare workers, so outbreak control still faces challenges. The ECDC published its 2024 measles epidemiological report: more than 35,000 cases were reported last year, nearly 10 times the more than 3,900 cases in 2023. The European region's outbreak began rising in 2023; the 2024 notification rate was 77.4 cases per million population, higher than 9.1 in 2023 and also higher than the pre-pandemic level (27.2). Romania had the highest rate, accounting for 87% of EU cases. Most cases were in infants under 1 year, but in some countries adults accounted for 28–53% of cases. Of last year's 23 deaths, 22 were in Romania, and more than half were children under 5. First-dose vaccination coverage in EU member states last year was 93.9%, lower than 94.2% in 2023; only 4 countries reached the 95% second-dose target, and most member states did not reach recommended vaccination levels.

I8VYk08ZZmiPVHXXs6HCUQ.zh: 澳大利亞昆士蘭州病例數顯著上升,今年截至4/6累計報告184例,為2024年同期之3倍以上,並報告26例死亡,今年1-3月病例數已超過2020-24年之各全年病例數。該州3月受洪水影響,環境中存在受污染土壤及汙水,增加慢性病等具潛在健康問題族群之感染風險。
I8VYk08ZZmiPVHXXs6HCUQ.en: Queensland, Australia, has seen a significant rise in cases: as of 6 April this year, 184 cases had been reported cumulatively, more than three times the same period in 2024, and 26 deaths were reported. Cases from January to March this year already exceed the full-year totals for each year from 2020 to 2024. In March the state was affected by flooding, leaving contaminated soil and wastewater in the environment, which increases the infection risk for people with chronic conditions and other potential health problems.

bsUMud0j45AiRUqyLifeNQ.zh: 菲律賓疫情上升,最近2週報告約14,000例病例,今年截至3/15累計報告76,000餘例病例,較去年同期上升約78%,以卡拉巴松15,000餘例病例為最多,其次為首都地區和呂宋島中部。 澳大利亞疫情更新,昆士蘭州湯斯維爾市2/19宣布爆發疫情,截至3/25累計9例確診病例及2例疑病例。
bsUMud0j45AiRUqyLifeNQ.en: Dengue is rising in the Philippines, with about 14,000 cases reported in the past two weeks. As of 15 March this year, more than 76,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, about 78% higher than the same period last year. Calabarzon region has the most cases, with over 15,000, followed by the National Capital Region and central Luzon. Australia update: an outbreak was declared in Townsville, Queensland, on 19 February; as of 25 March, 9 confirmed and 2 suspected cases have been reported cumulatively.

xK9mzI5i5cuZ3nAMzGYXew.zh: 澳洲疫情更新,西澳州今年迄今累計3例病例,已有1例死亡,病例主要分布於該州北部金伯利及皮爾布拉等地區,北部雨季及之後時期為該區蚊媒活動高風險期。2023年為該州12年來疫情較嚴重之一年,累計6例病例,其中2例死亡。
xK9mzI5i5cuZ3nAMzGYXew.en: Australia update: in Western Australia, 3 cases have been reported cumulatively so far this year, and 1 has died. Cases are mainly in the Kimberley and Pilbara areas of the north of the state. The northern wet season and the period after it is a high-risk period for mosquito-borne transmission in the area. 2023 was a more severe year in the state over the past 12 years, with 6 cases cumulatively, 2 of them fatal.

4eARB-eyLalV2EeoFCzUOw.zh: 多國疫情持續:  韓國自去年12月迄今報告18例,其中13例為境外移入,病例皆來自越南;香港報告今年首例,為越南境外移入個案;日本第10週(3/6-12)新增12例,新增病例數為今年以來新高,累計報告22例,其中15例為境外移入,感染國家以越南(10例)為多,近期發現數例未有境外旅遊史個案,該國將於4月舉行大型博覽會,海外遊客眾多,呼籲加強相關防疫措施。 美國中南部疫情持續,截至3/18累計報告317例(德州279例/新墨西哥州38例),其中38例住院,2例死亡,另鄰近奧克拉荷馬州報告4例與此次疫情相關病例,該國今年截至3/13共15州報告301例,並於3/7發布麻疹疫情健康警示。 澳洲今年迄今報告29例,病例多來自維多利亞州及新南威爾斯州,兩州各報告13例,病例多為境外移入,感染國包含越南、印等國,該國2023-24年分別報告26及57例。
4eARB-eyLalV2EeoFCzUOw.en: Measles continues in several countries. South Korea has reported 18 cases since last December, 13 of them imported, all from Viet Nam. Hong Kong reported its first case this year, an imported case from Viet Nam. Japan added 12 cases in week 10 (6–12 March), the highest weekly number this year, bringing the cumulative total to 22, of which 15 were imported. Viet Nam is the most common source country, with 10 cases. Several recent cases had no overseas travel history. Japan will host a large expo in April with many overseas visitors, and authorities call for strengthened preventive measures. The US south-central outbreak continues: as of 18 March, 317 cases had been reported cumulatively (Texas 279, New Mexico 38), of which 38 were hospitalized and 2 died. Neighbouring Oklahoma reported 4 cases related to this outbreak. As of 13 March, 15 states had reported 301 cases this year, and on 7 March the US issued a health alert on measles. Australia has reported 29 cases so far this year, mostly from Victoria and New South Wales, with 13 cases in each. Most cases are imported, from countries including Viet Nam and India. Australia reported 26 cases in 2023 and 57 in 2024.

FL6k5JLHsXzrOrg5kLb9mQ.zh: 澳洲疫情更新,新南威爾斯州報告今年第2例死亡病例,為70多歲男性,於3/6死亡,為該州自2022年以來之第4例死亡病例。
FL6k5JLHsXzrOrg5kLb9mQ.en: Australia update: New South Wales has reported the state's second death this year, a man in his 70s who died on 6 March. This is the state's fourth death since 2022.

YBmEe4avrWf61QpPwXGwIg.zh: 澳洲疫情更新,該國東北部昆士蘭州2024年累計報告2,477例病例,高於2023年的699例,症狀包括發燒、寒顫、頭痛、疼痛等,近幾年濕熱天氣造成蚊子繁殖且數量增加,以致疾病傳播風險上升,防蚊措施可降低感染風險。
YBmEe4avrWf61QpPwXGwIg.en: Australian epidemic update: In 2024, Queensland, in the northeast of the country, reported a cumulative 2,477 cases, higher than the 699 cases in 2023. Symptoms include fever, chills, headache and pain. Hot, humid weather in recent years has led to increased mosquito breeding and numbers, raising the risk of transmission. Mosquito-prevention measures can reduce the risk of infection.

VmQLD5YRejYx8ezdM7dqmQ.zh: 多國疫情上升,病例數高於歷年同期:  亞洲:中國去(2024)年報告49萬餘例,為2023年14倍,近期疫情已趨緩,病例數已降至單月1萬例以下;韓國去年報告逾4.7萬例,今(2025)年迄今報告已逾1,600例,遠高於往年單年不超過千例水平;日本病例數持續上升,近期處高點,惟疫情仍低於新冠疫情前規模;越南去年報告1,000餘例,為2023年21.9倍。 大洋洲:澳洲於去年報告逾5.7萬例病例,為2023年23.3倍,今年初疫情持續,迄今累計報告逾3,000例;紐西蘭自去年10月中旬迄今累計報告1,200餘例,其中101例住院,1例死亡。 美洲:美國去年累計報告3.5萬餘例,為2023年同期的6倍,近期病例數呈上升趨勢;巴西去年報告逾6,000例,為2014年以來新高。
VmQLD5YRejYx8ezdM7dqmQ.en: Several countries have seen rising case numbers, above same-period levels in previous years. Asia: China reported over 490,000 cases last year (2024), 14 times the 2023 figure; the outbreak has recently eased, and monthly cases have fallen below 10,000. South Korea reported over 47,000 cases last year, and so far this year (2025) more than 1,600 cases, far above the level of previous years, when no single year exceeded 1,000 cases. Japan's case numbers continue to rise and are currently near a peak, although the outbreak remains below the scale seen before the COVID-19 pandemic. Viet Nam reported over 1,000 cases last year, 21.9 times the 2023 figure. Oceania: Australia reported over 57,000 cases last year, 23.3 times the 2023 figure; the outbreak continued into early this year, with over 3,000 cases reported so far. New Zealand has reported over 1,200 cases cumulatively since mid-October last year, of which 101 were hospitalised and 1 died. Americas: The United States reported over 35,000 cases last year, six times the same period of 2023, and case numbers are rising. Brazil reported over 6,000 cases last year, the highest since 2014.

HyWTWE6KeErdyAiBC2RCJA.zh: 澳洲疫情更新,該國東北部昆士蘭州湯斯維爾報告1例病例,個案已入院治療,該州最近一次報告病例為2022年5月。 馬來西亞疫情更新,該國砂拉越州沐膠報告1例病例,當局已採取疫苗接種措施。
HyWTWE6KeErdyAiBC2RCJA.en: Australia epidemic update: In Townsville, Queensland State in the northeast, one case was reported; the patient has been admitted for treatment. The most recent previous case reported in the state was in May 2022. Malaysia epidemic update: In Mukah, Sarawak State, one case was reported, and authorities have implemented vaccination measures.

r6FgADjZggwIUNilx63u-A.zh: 全球疫情更新,去年截至11月累計逾1,400萬例病例及1萬例死亡,病例主要分布於美洲區報告逾1,250萬例病例及7,000例死亡,以巴西報告逾1,000萬例病例為多,其次為阿根廷、墨西哥、哥倫比亞、巴拉圭。 澳洲疫情更新,該國東北部昆士蘭州湯斯維爾報告1例病例,為該市五年來首例本土病例。
r6FgADjZggwIUNilx63u-A.en: Global update: Last year, up to November, over 14 million cases and 10,000 deaths were reported worldwide. Cases were mainly in the Region of the Americas, which reported over 12.5 million cases and 7,000 deaths, with Brazil reporting over 10 million cases, followed by Argentina, Mexico, Colombia and Paraguay. Australia update: Townsville in Queensland State in the northeast reported one case, the city's first locally acquired case in five years.

zh3OdUOp--PTRP0ZHhQrtQ.zh: 澳洲疫情更新,維多利亞州報告1例疑病例,可能為該州本季首例病例,於該州北部墨累河沿岸之環境監測及新南威爾斯州之蚊及豬隻亦檢出病毒,顯示該病毒可能於維多利亞州北部傳播,該州已對於高風險族群提供疫苗接種服務。
zh3OdUOp--PTRP0ZHhQrtQ.en: Australia epidemic update: Victoria State reported one suspected case, which may be the state's first case this season. The virus was also detected through environmental monitoring along the Murray River in northern Victoria, and in mosquitoes and pigs in New South Wales, indicating that the virus may be spreading in northern Victoria. The state has provided vaccination services to high-risk groups.

F5sIzm5Rr4eGoqfgVv6TEA.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 12/12-12/18期間,巴基斯坦新增4例WPV1病例;共2國新增7例cVDPV2,分別為查德4例、奈及利亞3例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增8件WPV1陽性樣本;共8國新增23件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為德國7件、英國5件、奈及利亞/南蘇丹各3 件、查德2件、喀麥隆/象牙海岸/芬蘭各1件。 澳洲墨爾本於汙水中檢出VDPV2陽性樣本,經檢測可能與海外接種小兒麻痺活性疫苗人員相關,並於維多利亞州境內持續散播,當局表示當地疫苗接種率高且汙水經有效處理,評估傳播風險為低。
F5sIzm5Rr4eGoqfgVv6TEA.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 12–18 December, Pakistan reported four new WPV1 cases. Two countries reported seven new cVDPV2 cases: four in Chad and three in Nigeria. For environmental samples, Pakistan reported eight new WPV1-positive samples. Eight countries reported 23 new cVDPV2-positive samples: seven in Germany, five in the United Kingdom, three each in Nigeria and South Sudan, two in Chad, and one each in Cameroon, Côte d'Ivoire and Finland. In Australia, VDPV2-positive samples were detected in wastewater in Melbourne. Testing suggests they may be linked to personnel who received live oral polio vaccine overseas, and the virus continues to spread within Victoria State. Authorities state that vaccination coverage in the area is high and wastewater is effectively treated, and they assess the transmission risk as low.
